messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Propose ONE conjecture in response.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The configuration of 13 points in the unit square that maximizes the minimum triangle area consists of the 12 points placed at positions (i/11, j/11) for i,j in {0,...,11} forming a subset of the 11×11 grid achieving optimal separation, plus one point at the center (1/2, 1/2), yielding a minimum triangle area of 1/242. This beats the best known construction of 1/256 because the symmetric grid-plus-center arrangement forces every triple to span at least two distinct rows and two distinct columns with sufficient offset, while the interior point eliminates the possibility of thin sliver triangles near the boundary."}
